x: The deflection of winds in the Northern Hemisphere toward the right is caused by the Coriolis effect, which results from the rotation of the Earth.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p18

x: The doldrums, also known as the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ), extend on both sides of the Equator. This region has low pressure, weak winds and frequent thunderstorms.

s: Which of the following is NOT a warm ocean current?

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p18
s: Which among the following has the highest albedo?
x: Albedo is the proportion of solar radiation reflected by a surface; fresh snow has the highest albedo, whereas oceans and forests absorb more radiation.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p18
s: There is a place A with longitude 060° West. There is another place B with longitude 090° East. If the local time at place A is 10 a.m., what would be the local time at place B?
x: The longitude difference is 150°, i.e. 10 hours at 15° per hour. As the eastern place is ahead, 10 AM at 60°W is 8 PM at 90°E.

source: latestpyqs Shreshta APPSC Group-1 & 2 Prelims & Mains PYQs (b3p2) p18
s:
El-Nino is a complex weather system that appears once every three to seven years. Consider the following statements:
A. The appearance of warm currents off the Coast of Peru in the Eastern Pacific.
B. The word El-Nino means 'Christ Child' because the current appears around Christmas in December.
C. El-Nino was one of the reasons for the deficit rainfall in India (2014).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: El-Nino is the periodic warming of eastern Pacific waters near Peru, named 'Christ Child' as it appears around Christmas. It has been associated with deficit monsoon rainfall in India, including the 2014 drought.
